name: Kempinski Hotel Corvinus Budapest
positioning: Central Budapest hotel on Erzsébet tér, across from the Ferris Wheel and near Fashion Street
best_for: Travelers who want to walk to St Stephen's Basilica and the Opera House

facts.text: The hotel is across Erzsébet tér from the Ferris Wheel and near the boutiques of Fashion Street.
St Stephen's Basilica is 8 minutes on foot, the State Opera House 11 minutes and the Parliament 18 minutes.
For an evening, the hotel suggests a drink at Blue Fox The Bar, then Hungarian and Viennese cooking at ÉS Bisztró or Japanese-Peruvian dishes at Nobu.
ÉS Bisztró serves Hungarian and Viennese classics, with Wiener Schnitzel anchoring the menu and a Negroni on tap.
The hotel has its own 24/7 guarded car park in the basement.
Electric vehicle fast chargers are available in the underground car park.
Pets are welcome; guests note it in the reservation and the hotel prepares a basket, rug, bowl and welcome treat.
Families get a children's menu in the restaurants, child-sized robes and slippers, and a baby bath.
Babysitting can be arranged by the concierge.
The concierge team includes a Clefs d'Or member team.

highlights.text: Nobu Budapest is the first Nobu in Central and Eastern Europe, with a full sushi bar and a cocktail lounge pouring sakes.
The Budapest Ferris Wheel stands in Erzsébet square, right outside the hotel.
Blue Fox The Bar serves creative cocktails, has a view of the Ferris wheel and has live music through the weekend.
Afternoon tea is served by the fireplace at The Living Room, and the hotel has a spa, Kempinski The Spa.

considerations.text: Pets are not allowed in Kempinski The Spa, ÉS Bisztró, The Living Room, Blue Fox The Bar or the meeting rooms.
Széchenyi Bath is a ride out from the hotel rather than a stroll.
The car park charges a parking fee during car charging.
